title.narrative: Education Sector Program I (Capacity Development Grant)

description.narrative: This capacity development grant will support the preparation of and the transition to a 1-12 school system.

contact-info.website: https://www.adb.org/forms/request-information-form?topic=projects&source=PDS&subject=35174-022 (Closed)&officer= rhayashi@adb.org&division= Human and Social Development Division, SARD&projectcountry= Nepal

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: A. Increased access to and improved quality and efficiency of basic and primary education in accordance with EFA B. Increased stakeholder capacity in policy analysis, formulation, and sectorwide planning and processes

A. Nepal Education for All (EFA), 2004-2009 Expanding ECD and PPC services to poor and disadvantaged children - GER for ECD/PPC from 13% (2001) to 51% (2009) - New entrants in Grade 1 with ECD from 8% ( 2001) to 60% (2009) Data Source: Project reports

B. Preparation for 1-12 School Sector Reform - Education legal and regulatory framework adjusted for 1-12 by 2009 - Sector and school financing system adjusted for 1-12 by 2009 - Central and local sector operations management adjusted for 1-12 by 2009
Eliminating gender disparity - Gender parity for grades 1-5 from 0.6% (2001) to 0.9% (2009) Data Source: ASIP

Ensuring access to education for all children - NER for grades 1-5 from 81% (2001) to 96% (2009) - Gross intake rate at Grade 1 from 141 (2001) to 110% (2009) - Net intake rate at Grade 1 from 54% (2001) to 95% (2009) - GER primary from 123% (2001) to 104% (2009) Data Source: Semiannual reports

Improving all aspects of quality education - Pupil-teacher ratio at primary level from 39:1(2001) to 37:1 (2009) - Percentage of teachers with required qualification and training from 15% (2001) to 99% (2009) - Percentage of teachers with required certification (no data for 2001) to 99% (2009) - Percentage of learning achievement at grade 5 average from 40% (2001) to 60% (2009)

Meeting the learning needs of all children - Repetition rate at Grade 1 from 39% (2001) to 10% (2009) - Repetition rate at Grade 5 from 9% (2001) to 3% (2009) - Survival rate to Grade 5 from 66% (2001) to 86% (2009) Data Source: National budgets

Reducing adult illiteracy - Literacy rate 15+ from 48% (2001) to 66% (2009) - Literacy rate age group 15-24 from 70% (2001) to 82% (2009) - Literacy rate 6+ from 54% (2001) to 76% ( 2009) - Literacy gender parity index 15+ from 0.6% (2001) to 0.9% (2009) Data Source: National red book
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 2. Preparation for a 1-12 school sector reform and restructuring, and Improvement in EFA Indicator: Enhanced Decentralization - Share of subsector non-salary budget transferred to schools as grants 60% by 2009 Data Source: EMIS data

Output: Indicator Indicator: Capacity in policy functions strengthened - Education Policy Committee (EPC) mobilized by 2006 - Technical secretariat established by 2006 Thematic group briefing papers on governance, finance, equity, quality issues in school sector prepared by 2007 - EPC position papers on system governance, finance, equity, quality in school sector prepared by 2007 - EPC position papers disseminated by MOES, discussed in public forums by 2007 - Framework for 1-12 school sector finalized by 2007

Output: Indicator Indicator: Core document for 1-12 sector prepared - Core document group mobilized by 2006 - Draft core document prepared by mid-2007 - Consultation with stakeholders at national level and in 25 districts, completed by 2007 - Core document finalized by 2008

Output: Indicator Indicator: EFA Implementation Further Improved - Time-bound action plans for program improvement endorsed at MTR in 2007, and implemented in 2008 - Refined strategy for gender and social inclusion, including scholarship management, and recruitment of female and Dalit teachers endorsed by the vulnerable communities development working group and implemented by DOE after the MTR in 2007 - Immediate actions to improve financial management initiated by the financial management task force in 2007

Output: Indicator Indicator: Enhanced Quality and Relevance School environments become more conducive to learning - Percentage of accredited schools to be 50% for grade 1 and 10% for grade 2 (2009) - Number of schools providing transitional language support to non-Nepali speaking students increased to 300 by 2009 - Percentage of schools conducting social audits increased to 75% (cumulative) by 2009 Data Source: National budgets

Output: Indicator Indicator: Improved Access and Equity over Baseline a - Share of out-of-school girls reduced from baseline (24%) to 4% (2009) - Percentage of schools with required number of classrooms of acceptable standard increased from baseline (51%) to 82% (2009) - Percentage of schools with safe drinking water increased from baseline (59.4%) to 90% by 2009 - Percentage of schools with girls toilets increased from baseline (37.5%) to 80% (2009) Data Source: Project reports Semiannual reports

Output: Indicator Indicator: Improving Efficiency and Institutional Capacity - Percentage of subsector non-salary allocations in school grants increased from (2001) 2% to 20% (2009) - Number of schools completing school improvement plans increased from (2001) 8,000 to 18,000 (2009) - Share of schools receiving grants on time to 75% by 2009 - Schools receiving textbooks on time (no baseline data) 18,000 by 2009 Data Source: National red book
